analysis:
Reviewed both supplied local analyses against the canonical index, the full T-041 definition, and the available source replay. The analyses agree that the change adds documentation for DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_SSD_INCREMENTAL_CHECKPOINTS at docs/provider/cli-reference.md:1960, selecting complete rather than incremental checkpoints when disabled. That changed line is not replayed here, so its wording and implementation cannot be independently verified. The visible BASE excerpt at docs/provider/cli-reference.md:2001–2036 describes unchanged lifecycle, resource and enrollment settings; it establishes no new authorization, encryption, billing or exposure behavior.
No concrete regression is independently supported by this evidence. In particular, mentioning incremental checkpoints does not prove that authentication, account isolation, expiration or memory bounds are missing. T-041, TB-007 and A-001 are the relevant cache contracts: keyed disk identities, authenticated model/layout/scope bindings, bounded staging, 30-minute reuse limits and recomputation on invalid data.
Material uncertainty remains because integration_source omits four of five reviewed source units and includes neither the changed row nor executable cache changes. The next pass should verify the actual diff and, if checkpoint behavior changes in this PR, examine SSDPrefixCachePolicy.swift and its changed write/restore consumers for authenticated dependency binding, bounded reconstruction, expiration/corruption handling and preserved cache-disable semantics. Verify LaunchAgent.swift passthrough only if changed or needed to validate the new documented option. This is a coverage limitation, not a finding or deployment qualification.
